responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module specifies the conversion API implemented by m2convert.cc. It exposes the frontend’s tree-building operations for VAL-style conversion, constant checked conversion, string conversion, pointer conversion, and canonical coercions to Modula-2 fundamental system types such as WORD, CARDINAL, INTEGER, BITSET, and generic ISO word-like types.
same_name_distinction: This is the Modula-2 definition-module API for conversion routines such as BuildConvert, ConvertConstantAndCheck, and the ToWord/ToInteger family. Unlike m2convert.h it is tailored to Modula-2 callers, and unlike m2convert.cc it has no coercion or warning logic.
